_comment: FactoryForge tag id -> PLCSIM Advanced tag name, for the native Simulation Runtime API driver (--driver plcsim-advanced). These are the names the API's own tag list reports: dotted, and WITHOUT the quotes an OPC UA NodeId needs. See examples/opcua_mapping.json for the OPC UA form of the same DB.
_instance: The instance name is whatever the PLCSIM Advanced control panel shows, not necessarily the CPU name in TIA. List them with SimulationRuntimeManager.RegisteredInstanceInfo if unsure.
_note_operator_tags: The operator and fault tags (panel.start/stop/reset/estop/setpoint, <drive>.fault) are deliberately NOT mapped here. This file matches examples/tia/FF_IO_datablock.md, whose byte layout was verified against a live CPU, and the ten tags below are the reference line's original I/O. To drive the panel or raise a fault from a real PLC, add the members to FF_IO yourself and extend this file — an unmapped tag is simply not exchanged, so nothing here breaks in the meantime.
